question: What are the institutional delivery coverage and postnatal check within 48 hours coverage for each district in 2021, 2022, and 2023, and how do they compare across districts?

view.title: Maternal Health Coverage by District and Year
view.note: The dataset provides coverage percentages derived from registered pregnancies. No intervention recommendations are available in this file.

interpretation_guard.caveat: The synthetic dataset cannot explain why coverage varies across districts.
